question: Will $AI reach or exceed $0.025 at any point before Aug 31, 2026 (UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the CoinGecko USD spot price for the $AI token (CoinGecko slug: artificial-intelligence) reaches or exceeds $0.025 at any point strictly before Aug 31, 2026, 00:00 UTC.
- "No": Wins if the CoinGecko USD spot price for the $AI token (CoinGecko slug: artificial-intelligence) remains strictly below $0.025 at all times up to and including Aug 31, 2026, 00:00 UTC.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches" means any recorded spot price of $0.025000 or higher on CoinGecko for the $AI token (slug: artificial-intelligence) during the resolution window, including intraday highs, constitutes a crossing event. A closing price alone is not required.
